status: Implemented, locally running and verified. Full default search completed; all saved routes independently checked; browser interaction, history, memory and startup checks complete.

source.finalBrowserCache: 16 inactive tiles per source, one inactive zoom level, one map worker
source.sourceSizeMethod: scripts/source-size.mjs physical lines; normal readable formatting

decision: New jobs save only one preferred valid walk per displayed hike. Remove loop/start/direction alternatives from results and UI. Retain all planned discovery, every eligible start, strict route constraints, existing preference and fixed 60% ordered main-loop grouping. Existing immutable completed files and addressed GPX links remain usable.

inputs.change: Catalog format 2 stores one coordinate array per physical trail per gzip JSONL line. Graph, starts and measured coordinates are unchanged.

browser.scope: Same existing 71-hike saved job, isolated Chrome headless 1440x900, Apple M3 Metal. Browser physical footprint includes shared browser/GPU/native services and blank-tab overhead; it is not app-only memory. CPU 100% means one logical core. Process exits make some CDP whole-browser CPU-delta samples invalid; reported hover intervals have stable workers. External basemap caching and host activity are uncontrolled.

fullMap.note: Fresh headless Chrome with full five-region map, one zoom and no screenshot readbacks. Whole browser includes GPU/native/shared services, blank tabs and Chrome services. Peak remains material; bounded caches do not impose an absolute browser memory ceiling.

independentRealRoutes.method: Independent source-witness validator plus direct prepared directed edges, road limits, saved-geometry continuity/distance/gain, and no two displayed main loops meeting the 60% ordered similarity rule. No production solver/grouping imports.

longFrozenRequest.outcome: Cancelled explicitly after 30 seconds; not a completed/empty result.

verification.browserFunctional: Old saved URL restored preferred route and unchanged GPX. New 918-hike URL restored outside first history page. Native scroll and End key reach row 917 with 14 mounted rows. 121-job history has pages of 50,50,21; Newer works; closing unmounts all job cards. Profile cursor moves without boundary reloads; actual zoom preserves complete result scope.

changes.issue: Repeated GeoJSON upload and full-app profile hover renders
changes.fix: Memoize saved map inputs and route locations. Keep chart cursor local, coalesce motion with requestAnimationFrame and notify only the map marker.

changes.issue: CPU saturation and repeated solver allocation
changes.fix: One shared measured thread-CPU budget across loading/search/grouping/saving. Reuse forest arrays and precompute pass weights, circuit/ring facts and ranking scores.

changes.issue: Whole-file decoding spikes and worker heap alone insufficient
changes.fix: Stream gzip/checksums/size validation with backpressure; parse only chosen physical geometry records. Retain one section graph at a time. Add smaller worker heap and a whole-backend RSS watchdog.

changes.issue: Millions of duplicate candidate and saved walk rows
changes.fix: Retain one preferred candidate per circuit, save only fixed displayed representatives, store physical geometry once, and remove variant/candidate/options tables.

changes.issue: Synchronous million-row COUNT for result pages
changes.fix: Maintain counts transactionally in the worker, persist immutable counts in results, send final counts before publication, and reuse existing job metadata for old files.

changes.issue: Frequent FULL-durability progress writes and whole-history polling
changes.fix: Keep live compact progress in memory, checkpoint at most once a second, durably persist state transitions and inputs, index active/FIFO lookup, and page retained history. Poll active rows, slow down while idle/hidden, and directly restore old IDs.

changes.issue: Map marker rebuilds, unbounded list DOM and repeated hover geometry
changes.fix: Reconcile stable viewport clusters/markers at settled integer zooms. Virtualize continuous scrolling and bound the delayed hover LRU. Bound inactive tiles and map workers.
Fingerprint source, build configuration and dependency lock; reuse complete outputs. Rebuild after changes or missing outputs.

research.use: Measure CPU time rather than assume yielding limits CPU. Conservatively fall back to process CPU when thread accounting is unavailable.
Worker JS heap limits exclude native and buffer allocations; monitor backend RSS separately.
Use pipeline/async iteration for backpressure and propagate checksum, decode and stream failures before result publication.
Keep DELETE/FULL durability for critical writes, use a small page cache, disable mmap, and prefer disk temp storage.
Disk temporary storage can still buffer smaller operations; reduce the data volume rather than rely on PRAGMA alone.
Local motion state and stable inputs prevent repeated application and map work.
Cap inactive tile cache/zoom levels without truncating visible tiles.
Set one map worker before constructing the map.

limitations: CPU budgeting and RSS watchdogs are cooperative safeguards, not hard operating-system quotas. Long native calls, garbage collection and graphics work can burst; the RSS watchdog samples every 250 ms.
Backend RSS includes the real server, search worker and in-process measurement client; it excludes browser memory. Browser/GPU/shared-service memory is separate and still material.

Timings are descriptive, not statistically controlled. The improved full search overlapped short offline checks and browser diagnostics; filesystem cache and other apps were uncontrolled. No p90 claim.
The full run verifies identical displayed-hike counts and all new returned routes; old full-run displayed route IDs were not retained, so real-route identity equality is not claimed.
Bounded discovery can still miss valid hikes. No start, discovery allowance or submitted constraint was removed or relaxed.
Existing saved result files are preserved. Their old alternatives consume disk until the user manually deletes those jobs.
Rare main-loop delays remain under host contention: maximum 100ms memory-sampler gap was 1169.0ms versus 4962.7ms before; cause is not isolated.
